versions.changelog:
- Initial release of 驾驶证识别OCR skill.
- Supports recognition of Chinese driver's license main page (number, name, gender, nationality, address, date of birth, vehicle type, issue date, validity) and vice page (archive number) from image input.
- Requires API key; prompts user if the key is missing.
- Provides two functions: recognition from image URL or BASE64-encoded image.
